changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwAppointmentBookingGroup AS SELECT a.id, a.facility_id, a.patient_id, a.department_id, a.service_id, a.practitioner_id, a.source_type, a.total_duration_minutes, a.start_datetime, a.end_datetime, a.notes, a.created_by, a.created_date, a.last_modified_by, a.last_modified_date FROM public.appointment_booking_group a;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwAppointmentBookingGroup TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwAppointmentBookingGroup FROM report_user;
